title: Deferred hardening + follow-ups (consolidated tracker)
origin: Honest deferrals surfaced during MT-006/014/041/043/013-010/012 implementation + adversarial reviews (2026-07-02). Consolidated so they are not forgotten; split into dedicated MTs if/when prioritized.
deferred_items: D1 (backend test): moodboard PG round-trip test (atelier_moodboard_changed_positions_record_distinct_snapshots) is BLOCKED - it lives in atelier_core_data_tests.rs which has a parallel MT-031's broken uncommitted test (metadata_request_id borrow-of-moved at ~:1997) that fails the whole test binary. Move the moodboard test to a clean file (atelier_moodboard_tests.rs) once MT-031 WIP is resolved, and prove record P1/P2 -> distinct content_sha256 + MOODBOARD_SNAPSHOT_RECORDED events on managed PG.

D2 (moodboard UX): the isolated moodboard canvas exposes add/place/connect affordances that silently no-op after FIX-2 isolation (no new card appears; no data loss of existing geometry). Either round-trip add/connect into the snapshot or hide the affordances on the moodboard board.
D3 (memory): CkcMediaImageCache + PoseSourceImageCache are unbounded BTreeMaps of decoded textures - add LRU/size eviction so browsing many images does not grow memory unbounded.

D4 (test infra): mock-server tests (read_http_request .expect + tight accept/read timeouts) flake under heavy cargo load (ingest_facial, ingest_contact_sheet panic at test_atelier_panel.rs:683). Harden: longer/removed timeouts, no .expect panic, or serialize the mock tests.

D5 (MT-016 bug): argus_attaches_latest_posekit_export_to_ckc_sheet_artifacts_locally FAILS deterministically (test_atelier_panel.rs ~:2744) - CKC sheet-artifact attach does not preserve the Argus/model actor on the local linked_by detail. Fix in MT-016 (its RFV is questionable).
D6 (MT-013 layout): 3-panel book layout overflows below ~700px width; no narrow-width/empty-state Argus capture matrix. Responsive fix + capture coverage.

D7 (MT-043 posekit): right OpenPose viewport renders real keypoints from openpose_json, not the literal exported PNG bytes. Add an artifact-content byte-fetch route so it can show the exact exported PNG.

D8 (MT-020 future scope): the Leeseo LoRA-training-infra wishlist (GPU preflight/isolation, kohya scaffolding, experiment registry, dataset builder, member-separation, epoch sweep/keeper selection, training monitor, eval-harness) is SEPARATE training infrastructure, largely outside Atelier/CKC - a future WP, NOT built in the MT-020 prompt-feedback kernel. Tracked here so it is not forgotten; likely promote to its own WP.

D9 (MT-020 panel round-trip): the prompt-feedback native panel (Ingest sub-mode) is honestly WIP - buttons set status strings + Argus is steerable, but the live backend round-trip + drain loop (calling the AtelierClient::prompt_feedback_* builders and delivering results into the panel, mirroring the drain_*_backend pattern) is deferred. Named follow-up MT: wire the panel to the backend engine end-to-end.
D10 (MT-020 CSV import): the adapter imports CUIPP JSON rows; the handoff also lists a prompt_stress_manifest.csv fixture. Add a CSV prompt-stress reader to the adapter (JSON path already works).

D11 (MT-030 id-audit robustness): test_manual_pane_editors live_author_id_set() is a HAND-MAINTAINED allowlist, so id_audit only catches documented-but-not-allowlisted, never allowlisted-but-not-emitted (for non-atelier-ckc ids). Replace the hand list for atelier-ingest-facial-* (and ideally all) ids with a rendered-panel auto-audit mirroring id_audit_documented_ckc_author_ids_are_rendered_in_live_atelier_panel / rendered_ckc_panel_author_id_set, so drift can't accumulate.

D12 (MT-030 readouts): the Facial montage + export command results are surfaced only via the shared command receipt (result_artifact_ref); montage advertises an Argus-addressable tile map (argus://facial-review/<id>) and export a non-destructive manifest. Add dedicated montage/export content readouts (a model currently must chain facial_artifact_read to see tile addresses / manifest entries).

D13 (MT-030 input feedback): Facial numeric fields (shard_count/ttl/montage page/columns/rows/repeats) use .parse().ok()/.unwrap_or(default) so unparseable input silently coerces to the default with no visible feedback. Echo a parse note into the receipt so a model sees the coercion.

D14 (process gap, all WPs): test_manual_pane_editors (id_audit + no-sqlite + tab-doc coupled asserts) was NOT run by MT-010/017/018/020/032/042 - manual drift accumulated as RED tests only exposed when MT-030 first touched the manual. Every future MT that edits manual_content_editors.rs MUST run test_manual_pane_editors as a gate. Consider adding it to the build_rules manual-coverage gate.

D15 (MT-031 follow-ups): (a) envelope-wrap the OTHER 5 Facial review commands (claim/decision/status/montage/session) with durable HTTP-200 outcome envelopes + receipts, exactly like export got in MT-031 (MT-031 scoped to export per acceptance 'at least one blocked path'). (b) SPEC DECISION: a fully-decided Facial export that intentionally rejects/holds some images is currently labeled 'degraded' (funnel/problems non-empty) with a recovery_hint implying incompleteness - a plausible false-degraded that could push a model into needless recovery. Operator/spec to decide whether reject/hold-only exports should be 'succeeded'. (c) atelier_panel.rs:7600 doc comment ('surfaces the backend HTTP error text honestly') is now slightly incomplete (blocked/degraded/error arrive as Ok envelopes) - accurate only for genuine transport failures; tidy in a doc pass.

handoff.note: MT-044 tracker is ready for validator review as a split-resolution artifact only. No deferred product item is officially validated here; child MTs MT-045..MT-055 now carry implementer-side READY_FOR_VALIDATION contracts and remain validator_verdict PENDING. D6 remains RFV/PENDING under MT-023; D8/D14 are future/non-product follow-ups; D15b is blocked on spec/operator decision.

tracker_resolution.rationale: MT-044 is a consolidated tracker with disjoint code surfaces and proof gates. Authority requires one operator change per MT and per-MT file/proof ownership, so the tracker cannot be executed as one product microtask.
authority_evidence: .GOV/task_packets/WP-CKC-posekit-overhaul/MT-044.json deferred_items says split into dedicated MTs if/when prioritized
